name: Monthly close and variance review
description: Set up a repeatable tie-out, driver bridge, and approval record.

steps.title: Reconciliation
steps.markdown:
# Reconciliation

Record the source extract and cut-off. Compare dashboard totals to the source by measure and period. Log any unmatched rows and who will resolve them.

steps.title: Variance bridge
steps.markdown:
# Variance bridge

Start from the prior comparable period. Separate volume, rate, mix and one-off effects. Tie the bridge to the total movement.

steps.title: Sign-off
steps.markdown:
# Sign-off

Record the reviewer, review date, outstanding items and release decision. Record filter settings used for each sign-off check.
